subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps \u0014 Summit Retail
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jared Powell <jared.powell@summitretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps  Summit Retail

Hi Jared 

Great to meet the team on today's call. Quick recap and a simple ask so we can line up the right folks on our side:

Summary from discovery:
- Primary use case: product detail personalization at scale (site and email).
- Key constraints: 99th pctl latency target of 200ms, PII redaction, on-prem model option for checkout flows.
- Initial volume profile: ~1.2M requests/day; peak bursts tied to promotions.

Immediate asks / next steps for you:
1) Stakeholder mapping: can you share a short org chart or point us to the economic decision maker, the security/compliance contact, and the procurement person managing SOWs? If possible, include intro chains across product, security, and procurement.
2) Risk/requirements doc: any existing security questionnaire or data flow diagram would help Neha scope the checklist.
3) Timeline: when do you expect an internal procurement review (approx month)?

If it's easier, a one-page org chart or a short list of names + titles is perfect. Marissa will use this to prepare a short mutual action plan and a draft schedule for a tech workshop. Neha will follow up on security specifics once we have the contacts.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min alignment meeting next week (we can do Tue/Wed).

Thanks again  we think theres a clear fit here and want to make the buying path as painless as possible.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_solution_brief.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks for the recap, Rishi  good summary.

Quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Priya Mehra (VP, Digital Commerce)  she owns platform budget for personalization. Priya is looped here.
- Procurement: Tom Alvarez (Senior Procurement Manager)  he handles SOWs and vendor onboarding; looped.
- Security/compliance: Security team lead is Michael Chen (michael.chen@summitretail.com)  I can intro once we have a short scope.

Attached is a one-page org chart (summit_org_chart_v2.pdf) and a short procurement checklist that outlines our typical steps.

Timeline: Procurement intake starts mid-December for platform initiatives. If we can get a draft SOW + security doc by end of November, we should be on track for Jan procurement review.

I can also share a short intro note to Priya if you want  otherwise I can make the intros after you send the proposed agenda.

Jared

Thanks Jared  this is super helpful.

Priya / Tom  nice to meet you (virtually). Per Jared's note, quick proposed plan:
- Week of Nov 22: 30-min alignment call (intro + success criteria). Rishi + Marissa + Neha from Redwood; Jared + Priya + Tom from Summit. Please share availability.
- By Nov 26: Redwood to provide a draft mutual action plan (timeline, milestones) + a short SOW outline for procurement.
- By Nov 30: Neha to send a tailored security checklist and initial data-flow questions so Michael Chen can triage.

Marissa will run the alignment call and prepare a one-page MAP that maps decision milestones to owners. Neha  can you flag any must-have security blockers in the checklist before we send?

If helpful, Jared  feel free to share a short intro to Priya and Tom with the one-line context (we'll keep it succinct). Otherwise we can loop you in on the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765.

Appreciate the quick turn  excited to get this moving.
